newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Gulf Bank in $38mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: United Gulf Bank in $38mln loan facility.

text.p: HSBC Financial Services (Middle East) Ltd said it had completed a $38 million five-year term loan facility for United Gulf Bank.
UGB, the Bahrain-based offshore investment bank, is majority owned by Kuwait Investment Projects Co.

Institutions participating in the syndicated loan are Arab Banking Corp, The British Bank of the Middle East, Chang Hwa Commercial Bank, Emirates Bank International, National Bank of Egypt International, Societe General, Westdeutsche Genossenschafts Zentralbank EG and Banca Popolare di Novara .

"Pricing is 75 basis points over Libor for the first three years, rising to 90 points over Libor for the remaining two years if banks decide not to recall funds at the put option," HSBC Financial Services said in a statement.
